description: This PHP class 'TimesheetItemDecorator' provides a decorator pattern implementation for the TimesheetItem entity, offering methods to associate related entities (Project, ProjectActivity, Timesheet, Employee) by their IDs and to format the start date of a timesheet item.

classes.name: TimesheetItemDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for TimesheetItem providing convenience methods to associate related entities by IDs and format date information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the decorator with a TimesheetItem entity.

methods.name: setProjectById
methods.description: Associates a Project entity with the TimesheetItem based on the provided project ID.

methods.name: setProjectActivityById
methods.description: Associates a ProjectActivity entity with the TimesheetItem based on the provided ID.

methods.name: setTimesheetById
methods.description: Associates a Timesheet entity with the TimesheetItem based on the provided Timesheet ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the TimesheetItem based on the employee number.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the timesheet item formatted as a string.
